mapper.select: SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, m.batch_enabled, m.serial_enabled FROM mes_wo_supplement_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id WHERE i.supp_id = #{suppId} ORDER BY i.id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO mes_wo_supplement_item (supp_id, material_id, qty, issued_qty, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{i.suppId}, #{i.materialId}, #{i.qty}, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE mes_wo_supplement_item SET issued_qty = issued_qty + #{qty}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND issued_qty + #{qty} <= qty
